scope: East & Southeast Texas (Smith, Gregg, Angelina, Nacogdoches, Jefferson counties; Tyler, Longview, Lufkin, Nacogdoches, Beaumont, Port Arthur)

records.name: Andrews Behavioral Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.organization: Andrews Behavioral Health (Andrews Center Behavioral Healthcare System)
records.description_en: Mental health care for adults and youth, substance use treatment, help for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, and 24/7 crisis help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Smith, Henderson, Rains, Van Zandt, and Wood counties who need mental health, substance use, or disability services. Anyone in a mental health crisis can call the crisis line any time.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Smith, Henderson, Rains, Van Zandt, or Wood County

records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call the 24/7 crisis line at (877) 934-2131 or 988. For regular services, call the Tyler clinic at (903) 597-1351.
records.hours: Crisis line 24/7
records.notes: Tyler clinic main phone (903) 597-1351. HHS crisis services page lists Andrews Center as the LMHA for Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt and Wood counties (crisis 877-934-2131). Also offers veteran services and child autism services.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, apoyo para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo, y ayuda en crisis las 24 horas, los 7 días.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Smith, Henderson, Rains, Van Zandt y Wood que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidad. Cualquier persona en una crisis de salud mental puede llamar a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al (877) 934-2131 o al 988. Para servicios regulares, llame a la clínica de Tyler al (903) 597-1351.

records.name: Community Healthcore (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, crisis, and disability services, plus primary care, for people in Gregg County and nearby counties. Crisis help is available by phone.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Bowie, Cass, Gregg, Harrison, Marion, Panola, Red River, Rusk, and Upshur counties. Accepts Medicaid, Medicare, many insurance plans, and has a sliding fee based on income.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Gregg County or another Community Healthcore service county

records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call (800) 832-1009 or 988. For services in Longview, call the adult mental health clinic at (903) 297-1852 or the main line (800) 446-8253.
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on income; Medicaid, Medicare and many insurance plans accepted
records.notes: Longview sites: Adult Mental Health & Primary Care, 1300 N. Sixth St (903) 297-1852; Substance Use & Crisis Services, 950 N. Fourth St (903) 758-0596; Children & Adolescent Services, 3110 H.G. Mosley Pkwy Ste 104 (903) 234-9200; Admin, 107 Woodbine Pl (903) 758-2471; Veterans Services (903) 291-1155. Crisis number and counties also confirmed on the HHS crisis services page. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias, crisis y discapacidad, además de atención primaria, para personas en el condado de Gregg y condados cercanos. Puede pedir ayuda en crisis por teléfono.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados de Bowie, Cass, Gregg, Harrison, Marion, Panola, Red River, Rusk y Upshur. Aceptan Medicaid, Medicare, muchos seguros médicos y tienen una tarifa según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al (800) 832-1009 o al 988. Para servicios en Longview, llame a la clínica de salud mental para adultos al (903) 297-1852 o a la línea principal al (800) 446-8253.

records.name: Burke Center Crisis Line (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Burke Center is the public mental health agency for Angelina, Nacogdoches, and nearby counties. Call the crisis line any time for help in a mental health crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Angelina, Houston, Nacogdoches, Newton, Polk, Sabine, San Augustine, San Jacinto, Shelby, Trinity, and Tyler counties.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Angelina, Nacogdoches, or another Burke Center service county

records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis line at (800) 392-8343, or call or text 988. Ask about ongoing services.
records.notes: Burke Center's own website returned no usable content this session, so address, hours, and clinic phone numbers were not confirmed.
records.description_es: Burke Center es la agencia pública de salud mental para Angelina, Nacogdoches y condados cercanos. Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora si tiene una crisis de salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Angelina, Houston, Nacogdoches, Newton, Polk, Sabine, San Augustine, San Jacinto, Shelby, Trinity y Tyler.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis al (800) 392-8343, o llame o envíe un mensaje de texto al 988. Pregunte por los servicios continuos.

records.name: Spindletop Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Mental health care, substance use recovery, disability services, and 24/7 crisis help for Jefferson County and nearby counties. Walk-in crisis help is offered on weekdays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Chambers, Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, and Orange counties. No one is turned away for inability to pay.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Jefferson, Chambers, Hardin, Jasper, or Orange County

records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis line at (800) 937-8097, or walk in on weekdays 8 AM-4 PM. For intake, go to the South Campus at 2750 S. 8th Street in Beaumont or call (409) 839-1000.
records.hours: Crisis line 24/7; walk-in crisis services weekdays 8:00 AM-4:00 PM; clinics 8 AM-5 PM
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on family size and income; no one turned away for inability to pay
records.notes: Main line (409) 839-1000. Port Arthur clinic: 3401 57th Street, Port Arthur, TX 77642, (409) 813-8300. Crisis page lists walk-in crisis screening 8 AM-4 PM Mon-Fri (locations page shows 8 AM-5 PM clinic hours). Mobile crisis outreach after hours via crisis line. Counties confirmed on HHS crisis services page.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental, recuperación del uso de sustancias, servicios para discapacidades y ayuda en crisis las 24 horas para el condado de Jefferson y condados cercanos. Entre semana puede llegar sin cita para recibir ayuda en crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados de Chambers, Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson y Orange. No se le niega el servicio a nadie por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al (800) 937-8097, o vaya sin cita entre semana de 8 AM a 4 PM. Para iniciar servicios, vaya al South Campus en 2750 S. 8th Street en Beaumont o llame al (409) 839-1000.

records.name: Lone Star Legal Aid - Tyler Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for people with low income, such as problems with landlords and evictions, public benefits, family issues, and debt.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem in Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt, and Wood counties. You must meet income and legal status rules.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt, and Wood counties

records.how_to_apply: Walk in, call, or apply online. Intake hours are Monday-Thursday 8:30 AM-12 PM and 1:00-3:30 PM. Emergencies are taken any time the office is open.
records.hours: Office Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. Intake Mon-Thu 8:30 AM-12 PM and 1:00-3:30 PM; emergency intakes accepted during all office hours
records.notes: Office toll-free (800) 248-0048. Statewide toll-free intake (800) 733-8394. Online application link from lonestarlegal.org homepage.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas de bajos ingresos, por ejemplo con problemas con el dueño de la vivienda y desalojos, beneficios públicos, asuntos de familia y deudas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos con un problema legal civil (no penal) en los condados de Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt y Wood. Debe cumplir con requisitos de ingresos y de estatus legal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina, llame o solicite en línea. El horario para nuevas solicitudes es de lunes a jueves, de 8:30 AM a 12 PM y de 1:00 a 3:30 PM. Las emergencias se atienden en cualquier momento en que la oficina esté abierta.

records.name: Workforce Solutions East Texas - Tyler Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, career services, and help for veterans, young adults, and laid-off workers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in the East Texas workforce area, including Smith and Gregg counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Tyler center Monday-Friday, 8 AM-5 PM, or call 1-844-ETWORKS (1-844-389-6757).
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.notes: Official locations page lists 1-844-ETWORKS (1-844-389-6757) for both Tyler and Longview centers; earlier local number (903) 561-8131 could not be confirmed and was replaced. Board serves Anderson, Camp, Cherokee, Gregg, Harrison, Henderson, Marion, Panola, Rains, Rusk, Smith, Upshur, Van Zandt, and Wood counties. Email callcentermailbox@easttexasworkforce.org.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, capacitación laboral, servicios de carrera y apoyo para veteranos, jóvenes adultos y personas que perdieron su empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el área de East Texas, incluyendo los condados de Smith y Gregg.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Tyler de lunes a viernes, de 8 AM a 5 PM, o llame al 1-844-ETWORKS (1-844-389-6757).

records.name: Workforce Solutions East Texas - Longview Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, career services, and help for veterans, young adults, and laid-off workers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in the East Texas workforce area, including Gregg and Smith counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Longview center Monday-Friday, 8 AM-5 PM, or call 1-844-ETWORKS (1-844-389-6757).
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM

Board serves Anderson, Camp, Cherokee, Gregg, Harrison, Henderson, Marion, Panola, Rains, Rusk, Smith, Upshur, Van Zandt, and Wood counties. Email callcentermailbox@easttexasworkforce.org.

records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el área de East Texas, incluyendo los condados de Gregg y Smith.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Longview de lunes a viernes, de 8 AM a 5 PM, o llame al 1-844-ETWORKS (1-844-389-6757).

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Assistance) - East Texas
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school or training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in the East Texas workforce area, including Smith and Gregg counties, with income at or below 85% of the state median income (for example, $7,670 a month for a family of 4).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Smith, Gregg, or another Workforce Solutions East Texas county

records.how_to_apply: Start on the parent page of the Workforce Solutions East Texas website or call (800) 676-8283.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.cost: Financial help; families may pay a share of cost
records.notes: Parent email customer@easttexasworkforce.org. Income example as stated on source; limits change yearly.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo, o estudiar o capacitarse.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del área de Workforce Solutions East Texas, incluyendo los condados de Smith y Gregg, con ingresos iguales o menores al 85% del ingreso medio del estado (por ejemplo, $7,670 al mes para una familia de 4).
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece en la página para padres del sitio web de Workforce Solutions East Texas o llame al (800) 676-8283.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Angelina County Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, job training, and employer services. Staff can also help parents with child care assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Angelina and nearby Deep East Texas counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call (936) 639-1351.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.notes: Board serves Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk, and Shelby counties. Text DETX to 936-251-6022 for job alerts.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación laboral y servicios para empleadores. El personal también puede ayudar a los padres con asistencia para el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en Angelina y condados cercanos de Deep East Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro o llame al (936) 639-1351.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Nacogdoches County Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, job training, and employer services. Staff can also help parents with child care assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Nacogdoches and nearby Deep East Texas counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call (936) 560-1441.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación laboral y servicios para empleadores. El personal también puede ayudar a los padres con asistencia para el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en Nacogdoches y condados cercanos de Deep East Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro o llame al (936) 560-1441.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Assistance) - Deep East Texas
records.description_en: Helps pay part of child care costs so parents can keep working or go to school. Families pay a co-payment based on income and household size.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible working or studying parents in Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk, and Shelby counties.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Angelina, Nacogdoches, Houston, Jasper, Polk, or Shelby County

records.how_to_apply: Start on the Parents page of the Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas website, or visit the Lufkin or Nacogdoches workforce center.
records.cost: Co-payment based on family income and household size
records.notes: Income limits not stated on source page. Lufkin center (936) 639-1351; Nacogdoches center (936) 560-1441.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar parte del costo del cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan seguir trabajando o estudiando. Las familias pagan un copago según sus ingresos y el tamaño del hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para padres que trabajan o estudian y que califican, en los condados de Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk y Shelby.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece en la página para padres (Parents) del sitio web de Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas, o visite el centro de empleo de Lufkin o de Nacogdoches.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Southeast Texas - Beaumont Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, career planning, job training, and services for veterans and young adults.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Jefferson, Orange, and Hardin counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Beaumont center or call (409) 839-8045.
records.notes: Main line 1-877-834-5627. Hours not stated on source.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, planear su carrera, capacitación laboral y servicios para veteranos y jóvenes adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en los condados de Jefferson, Orange y Hardin.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Beaumont o llame al (409) 839-8045.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Southeast Texas - Port Arthur Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, career planning, job training, and services for veterans and young adults.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Jefferson, Orange, and Hardin counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Port Arthur center or call (409) 962-1236.
records.notes: Main line 1-877-834-5627. Hours not stated on source.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, planear su carrera, capacitación laboral y servicios para veteranos y jóvenes adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en los condados de Jefferson, Orange y Hardin.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Port Arthur o llame al (409) 962-1236.

records.name: Child Care Contractor Services Southeast Texas
records.description_en: Free or low-cost child care help for parents who are working, looking for work, in job training, or in school.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For parents in Jefferson, Hardin, or Orange counties. Single parents need 25+ hours a week of work, school, or training (two-parent families 50+ combined hours). Children must be under 13 and a U.S. citizen or legal immigrant. Income limits apply.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Parent Application online through the Texas Workforce Commission child care portal (linked from workforcechildcare.org), or visit the Beaumont or Port Arthur office.
records.notes: Port Arthur office 4680 FM 365, (409) 962-1236. Email cccs@workforcechildcare.org. Main Workforce Solutions line 1-877-834-5627. Parent application: https://childcare.twc.texas.gov/find/welcome . max_age 12 reflects 'under 13'.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis o de bajo costo con el cuidado de niños para padres que trabajan, buscan trabajo, están en capacitación laboral o estudian.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para padres en los condados de Jefferson, Hardin u Orange. Si es padre o madre soltero(a), necesita 25 horas o más por semana de trabajo, estudio o capacitación (familias con dos padres: 50 horas o más entre los dos). Los niños deben ser menores de 13 años y ciudadanos de EE. UU. o inmigrantes legales. Hay límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud para padres en línea en el portal de cuidado de niños de la Comisión de la Fuerza Laboral de Texas (enlace en workforcechildcare.org), o visite la oficina de Beaumont o de Port Arthur.

records.name: Bethesda Health Clinic
records.description_en: Low-cost medical care, dental care, counseling, and pediatrics for uninsured working adults and families in East Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 18-64 (18-65 for dental) with no health or dental insurance who have a job or do significant unpaid work like caregiving, volunteering, or school. Children are seen at Bethesda Pediatrics.
documents_needed: Proof of income (recent pay stubs, employment letter, or awards letter)
records.how_to_apply: First-time applicants must apply in person during clinic hours; no appointment needed. Call (903) 596-8353 ext. 112 with questions.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 AM-5 PM, Fri 8 AM-1 PM
records.cost: Low cost; contact clinic for fees
records.notes: Must requalify every 2 years. Lindale Clinic: 215 W Margaret St, Lindale, (903) 255-7462 (limited hours). Pediatrics: 1350 E Richards St, Tyler, medical (903) 531-9455, dental (903) 593-7607. Locations/hours from https://bethesdaclinic.org/contact/ . Email admissions@bethesdaclinic.org.
records.description_es: Atención médica y dental de bajo costo, consejería y pediatría para adultos que trabajan y familias sin seguro en East Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 18 a 64 años (18 a 65 para dental) que no tienen seguro médico ni dental y que tienen trabajo o hacen trabajo importante sin pago, como cuidar a alguien, ser voluntario o estudiar. Los niños se atienden en Bethesda Pediatrics.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si solicita por primera vez, debe hacerlo en persona durante el horario de la clínica; no necesita cita. Si tiene preguntas, llame al (903) 596-8353, extensión 112.

records.name: Family Circle of Care (Community Health Center)
records.description_en: Community health center with primary care, pediatrics, women's health, dental, eye care, behavioral health, and substance use treatment.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, with or without insurance.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 535-9041 to make an appointment as a new patient.
records.cost: Affordable care; ask about fees based on income
records.notes: Federally funded health center. Tyler sites (from HRSA data https://data.hrsa.gov/DataDownload/DD_Files/Health_Center_Service_Delivery_and_LookAlike_Sites.csv): Glenwood Clinic 928 N Glenwood Blvd; Broadway Clinic 2990 N Broadway Ave (903-593-1893); Houston St. Clinic 214 E Houston St; W. Gentry Clinic 2231 W Gentry Pkwy; Dental 110 E 9th St (903-991-4990); Chapel Hill school clinic; mobile clinic. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con atención primaria, pediatría, salud de la mujer, dental, cuidado de los ojos, salud mental y tratamiento para el uso de sustancias.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos, con o sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 535-9041 para hacer una cita como paciente nuevo.

records.name: Wellness Pointe (Community Health Center)
records.description_en: Community health center with family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, dental, eye care, and behavioral health. Also offers WIC, parenting classes, and home visiting.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone in the area, with or without insurance.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 758-2610 or toll-free (888) 811-6648 to make an appointment.
records.notes: Health Center Program grantee. Longview sites: 1107 E Marshall Ave (main), 425 N Fredonia St, 2131 Mobberly Ave, 1761 W Loop 281, 802 Medical Circle, plus school clinics. HRSA data also lists Tyler sites: Women's Health Center at 825 Medical Dr, Tyler 75701, and Social Services at 401 E Front St, Tyler. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con medicina familiar, pediatría, salud de la mujer, dental, cuidado de los ojos y salud mental. También ofrece WIC, clases para padres y visitas al hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos en el área, con o sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 758-2610 o gratis al (888) 811-6648 para hacer una cita.

records.name: Special Health Resources for Texas (Community Health Center)
records.organization: Special Health Resources for Texas, Inc.
records.description_en: Community health center with clinics in Longview and Tyler offering pediatrics, women's health, primary care, and behavioral health.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Accepts Medicaid, Medicare, and most insurance, and gives self-pay discounts based on income and household size.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic you want to visit to make an appointment. Some clinics allow online booking.
records.cost: Self-pay discounts based on income and household size
records.notes: From specialhealth.org: Woman & Child Health Center, 402 N Seventh St, Longview (903) 212-7170; Longview Care Clinic, 409 N 6th St, Longview (903) 234-8808; Tyler Care Clinic - Troup Hwy, 4519 Troup Hwy, Tyler 75703 (903) 289-9252; Midtown Clinic of Tyler, 1300 Clinic Dr, Tyler 75701 (903) 597-7558. Main office 2020 Bill Owens Pkwy, Longview 75604, (903) 501-1747. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con clínicas en Longview y Tyler que ofrecen pediatría, salud de la mujer, atención primaria y salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Aceptan Medicaid, Medicare y la mayoría de los seguros, y dan descuentos a quienes pagan por su cuenta según sus ingresos y el tamaño del hogar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica que quiere visitar para hacer una cita. Algunas clínicas permiten hacer citas en línea.

records.name: East Texas Community Health Services (Community Health Center)
records.organization: East Texas Community Health Services, Inc.
records.description_en: Community health center with primary care, dental, pediatrics, chronic disease care, shots, family planning, counseling, lab tests, and a small pharmacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. People with no insurance or low coverage can pay less based on household income and family size.
records.how_to_apply: Call (936) 560-5668 to make an appointment. Same-day visits may be available.
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on household income and family size
records.notes: Clinics (addresses from HRSA data): Eastside Community Clinic, 1309 S University Dr, Nacogdoches; Westside Clinic, 1210 Douglass Rd, Nacogdoches (936-560-1122); LittleJacks Pediatrics, 4604 NE Stallings Dr, Nacogdoches (936-205-5805); Sayers Street Clinic, 1717 Sayers St, Lufkin (936-899-5368). After-hours nurse triage at main number.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con atención primaria, dental, pediatría, cuidado de enfermedades crónicas, vacunas, planificación familiar, consejería, análisis de laboratorio y una pequeña farmacia.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Las personas sin seguro o con poca cobertura pueden pagar menos según los ingresos y el tamaño de su familia.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (936) 560-5668 para hacer una cita. Puede haber citas para el mismo día.

records.name: HOPE Community Medicine - Lufkin
records.organization: Health Opportunities for the People of East Texas, Inc. (HOPE Community Medicine)
records.description_en: Nonprofit community health center with primary care, pediatrics, women's health, behavioral health, pharmacy, and help with insurance, rides, and food.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. No one is denied care because they cannot pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Lufkin clinic at (936) 248-4673, or the main line at (936) 591-8380, to make an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 AM-5 PM; Fri 8 AM-3 PM
records.cost: No one denied care for inability to pay
records.notes: Lufkin address, phone, and hours from hcmtx.org/locations. Main office: 304 Logansport St, Center, TX 75935, (936) 591-8380.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario sin fines de lucro con atención primaria, pediatría, salud de la mujer, salud mental, farmacia y ayuda con seguro médico, transporte y comida.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. A nadie se le niega atención por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de Lufkin al (936) 248-4673, o a la línea principal al (936) 591-8380, para hacer una cita.

records.name: TAN Healthcare - Beaumont Family Health Center
records.description_en: Community health center with primary care, HIV prevention and treatment, hepatitis C care, behavioral health, and mobile medical services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to insured and uninsured patients. Sliding fee scale available.
records.how_to_apply: Download a new patient application (English or Spanish) from the website, or call (409) 832-8338.
records.hours: Mon 7 AM-6 PM; Tue-Thu 8 AM-5 PM; Fri 8 AM-3 PM; closed daily 12-1 PM
records.notes: HRSA data also lists The Lester Daigle Behavioral Health Center at 2355 I-10 E, Beaumont (409-832-3377).
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con atención primaria, prevención y tratamiento del VIH, atención para la hepatitis C, salud mental y servicios médicos móviles.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para pacientes con y sin seguro médico. Hay tarifas según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud para pacientes nuevos (en inglés o español) del sitio web, o llame al (409) 832-8338.

records.name: Legacy Community Health - Beaumont Clinics
records.description_en: Community health clinics in Beaumont with adult primary care, pediatrics, women's health, behavioral health, and HIV testing and treatment.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Care is offered regardless of ability to pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call (832) 548-5000 to make an appointment. Same-day visits may be available.
records.cost: Care offered regardless of ability to pay; ask about fees
records.notes: Beaumont sites (HRSA data, 2026-09-26): Central Beaumont, 450 N 11th St (409-242-2577); Central Stagg, 3455 Stagg Dr (832-548-5100); Beaumont North / Taylor Pediatrics, 3030 North St. Scheduling line (832) 548-5000. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Clínicas de salud comunitaria en Beaumont con atención primaria para adultos, pediatría, salud de la mujer, salud mental y pruebas y tratamiento del VIH.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Se ofrece atención aunque no pueda pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (832) 548-5000 para hacer una cita. Puede haber citas para el mismo día.

records.name: Gulf Coast Health Center - Port Arthur
records.description_en: Federally funded community health center in Port Arthur with clinics, school-based clinics, and a mobile unit.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Community health centers see patients with or without insurance. Ask about income-based discounts.
records.how_to_apply: Call (409) 983-1161 to make an appointment.
records.notes: Confirmed active in HRSA health center site data (dated 2026-09-26). The organization's website (gulfcoasthc.org) had a certificate error, so hours and fees were not confirmed. Other Port Arthur sites: West Side, 601 Rev Dr Ransom Howard St; Park Plaza, 2927 Park Plaza Ln; school clinics at Memorial High School (3501 Lucien Adams Blvd) and Phillis Wheatley School (1100 Jefferson Dr); mobile unit.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con fondos federales en Port Arthur, con clínicas, clínicas en escuelas y una unidad móvil.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los centros de salud comunitarios atienden a pacientes con o sin seguro médico. Pregunte por descuentos según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (409) 983-1161 para hacer una cita.

records.name: Smith County Indigent Healthcare Program
records.description_en: County program that helps pay for basic health care for very low-income Smith County residents who cannot get Medicaid or other coverage.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Smith County residents who are single adults or couples without dependent children, with very low income (about 21% of the federal poverty level). Savings and property are counted.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 526-4405 to request an application. Staff will schedule an eligibility appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 AM-4:30 PM; closed Fridays
records.notes: Mailing address P.O. Box 132317, Tyler, TX 75713. Emergency line (903) 535-9701.
records.description_es: Programa del condado que ayuda a pagar atención médica básica para residentes del condado de Smith con ingresos muy bajos que no pueden obtener Medicaid u otra cobertura.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Smith que son adultos solos o parejas sin hijos dependientes, con ingresos muy bajos (cerca del 21% del nivel federal de pobreza). Se toman en cuenta los ahorros y las propiedades.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 526-4405 para pedir una solicitud. El personal le dará una cita para revisar si califica.

records.name: Angelina County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: County program that helps pay for medical care for very low-income Angelina County residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Angelina County residents who are single adults, non-pregnant people without dependent children, or couples without dependents, with income under about 21% of the federal poverty level. Assets are counted.
records.how_to_apply: Download the application packet from the county website or contact the office. Applications can also be turned in at hospitals.
records.notes: Mailing address P.O. Box 908, Lufkin, TX 75902. Administrator (936) 634-4232.
records.description_es: Programa del condado que ayuda a pagar atención médica para residentes del condado de Angelina con ingresos muy bajos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Angelina que son adultos solos, personas no embarazadas sin hijos dependientes, o parejas sin dependientes, con ingresos menores a cerca del 21% del nivel federal de pobreza. Se toman en cuenta los bienes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue el paquete de solicitud del sitio web del condado o comuníquese con la oficina. También puede entregar la solicitud en los hospitales.

records.name: Gregg County Health Department (Shots, Indigent Health Care, Utility Help)
records.description_en: County health office with walk-in shots, free STI testing, the county indigent health care program, and a utility assistance application.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves Gregg County residents. Indigent health care is for very low-income residents who qualify under county rules.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in for shots or testing during clinic hours. Apply for indigent health care online at applyihs.com/greggco or in person (8-11 AM, 1-4 PM).
records.hours: Office 7:30 AM-5:00 PM. Immunizations Mon/Wed/Fri 8:30-11:15 AM and 1:00-3:45 PM (closed Tue/Thu). Free STI testing Mon/Wed/Fri 7:30-9:30 AM.
records.cost: STI testing free; other fees not stated
records.notes: Also runs an indigent cremation program. Utility assistance eligibility not stated on source.
records.description_es: Oficina de salud del condado con vacunas sin cita, pruebas gratis de infecciones de transmisión sexual, el programa de atención médica para personas de bajos recursos del condado y una solicitud de ayuda con servicios públicos (luz, agua, gas).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a residentes del condado de Gregg. La atención médica para personas de bajos recursos es para residentes con ingresos muy bajos que califican según las reglas del condado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya sin cita para vacunas o pruebas durante el horario de la clínica. Solicite la atención médica para personas de bajos recursos en línea en applyihs.com/greggco o en persona (8-11 AM, 1-4 PM).

records.name: Jefferson County Indigent Health Care and Primary Health Care
records.description_en: County health programs for low-income residents: indigent health care (CIHCP), $10 doctor visits through Primary Health Care, free medicines and rides for CIHCP patients, and low-cost child shots.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Jefferson County residents who cannot get other state or federal help. The Primary Health Care program is for residents at or below 133% of the federal poverty guidelines.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit Unit #1 in Beaumont (409) 835-8530 or Unit #2 in Port Arthur (409) 983-8380.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.cost: Primary Health Care doctor visits $10 (no lab or hospital coverage); child immunizations $10/visit
records.notes: 133% FPL is for the Primary Health Care program; CIHCP follows state rules. Port Arthur Unit #2: 800 4th Street, Port Arthur 77640, (409) 983-8380. Immunization Clinic: 7933 Viterbo Road, Beaumont (Mon 8 AM-12 PM; Tue-Wed 12:30-4:30 PM) for uninsured/underinsured children under 18, $10/visit. Utility help (lights, water, gas) for eligible indigent patients.
records.description_es: Programas de salud del condado para residentes de bajos ingresos: atención médica para personas de bajos recursos (CIHCP), visitas al doctor por $10 con el programa de Atención Primaria, medicinas y transporte gratis para pacientes de CIHCP, y vacunas de bajo costo para niños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Jefferson que no pueden obtener otra ayuda estatal o federal. El programa de Atención Primaria es para residentes con ingresos iguales o menores al 133% de las guías federales de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la Unidad #1 en Beaumont (409) 835-8530 o la Unidad #2 en Port Arthur (409) 983-8380.

records.name: NET Health WIC - Tyler
records.organization: Northeast Texas Public Health District (NET Health)
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, and children under 5.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 592-7635 to make a WIC appointment at the North Broadway clinic.
records.hours: Mon 10 AM-7 PM; Tue-Fri 8:30 AM-5:30 PM
records.notes: Other Tyler WIC site: Tyler Family Care, 225 E. Amherst Ste 800, Tyler 75701, (903) 533-1319 (same hours). WIC admin (903) 593-8331.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, clases de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes y niños menores de 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con los requisitos de ingresos de WIC.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 592-7635 para hacer una cita de WIC en la clínica de North Broadway.

records.name: NET Health Immunization Clinic
records.organization: Northeast Texas Public Health District (NET Health)
records.description_en: Walk-in clinic with low-cost vaccines for children and adults, including school shots and flu shots.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone, no matter where you live. No one is turned away for inability to pay.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during clinic hours. No appointment needed.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8-11 AM and 1-4 PM; Wednesday afternoon until 6 PM
records.cost: Low-cost administration fee; no one turned away for inability to pay
records.notes: NET Health main line (903) 535-0030. Paperwork must be completed at every visit; specific documents not listed on source. Does not carry typhoid or yellow fever vaccines.
records.description_es: Clínica sin cita con vacunas de bajo costo para niños y adultos, incluyendo vacunas para la escuela y contra la gripe.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierta para cualquier persona, sin importar dónde viva. A nadie se le niega el servicio por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica. No necesita cita.

records.name: City of Port Arthur Health Department
records.description_en: City health department with shots, a TB clinic, STD testing and treatment, WIC, Nurse-Family Partnership, and vital records.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves Port Arthur area residents. Some clinics charge small fees.
records.how_to_apply: Call (409) 983-8874 or visit during business hours.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM
records.cost: Pregnancy test $10; call for other fees
records.notes: ZIP code not stated on source. Director of Health Services (409) 983-8832.
records.description_es: Departamento de salud de la ciudad con vacunas, clínica de tuberculosis, pruebas y tratamiento de enfermedades de transmisión sexual, WIC, el programa Nurse-Family Partnership y registros vitales (actas).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a residentes del área de Port Arthur. Algunas clínicas cobran pequeñas tarifas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (409) 983-8874 o visite en horario de oficina.

records.name: East Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Supplies food pantries and produce giveaways across East Texas and helps people apply for SNAP and other benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in the food bank's East Texas service area. Each pantry may have its own rules.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food tool on the website to find a pantry near you, or call (903) 597-3663.
records.notes: Resource centers in Tyler, Longview, Lufkin, and Texarkana. Official pages give 26 and 27 counties and do not list them by name; Smith, Gregg, and Angelina are inferred from HQ and resource centers. Nacogdoches not confirmed; use the Find Food tool.
records.description_es: Abastece despensas de comida y repartos de frutas y verduras en todo East Texas, y ayuda a las personas a solicitar SNAP y otros beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en el área de servicio del banco de comida en East Texas. Cada despensa puede tener sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta Find Food del sitio web para encontrar una despensa cerca de usted, o llame al (903) 597-3663.

records.name: Southeast Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Helps people find nearby food pantries and runs mobile pantries, senior food boxes, a child backpack program, TEFAP, and help signing up for benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine, and Tyler counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the website to find a pantry by county, or call (409) 839-8777.
records.description_es: Ayuda a las personas a encontrar despensas de comida cercanas y ofrece despensas móviles, cajas de comida para personas mayores, un programa de mochilas para niños, TEFAP y ayuda para inscribirse en beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los condados de Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine y Tyler.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el sitio web para buscar una despensa por condado, o llame al (409) 839-8777.

records.name: Hiway 80 Rescue Mission
records.description_en: Emergency shelter for men, women, and children, plus meals, showers, recovery programs, case management, and longer-term transitional housing.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people and families facing homelessness, crisis, addiction, abuse, or poverty in East Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 759-8101 or go to the mission in Longview.
records.notes: Christian faith-based. Serves Tyler and Longview. Gateway to Hope day resource center and Triumph Village transitional living are in Tyler. Hours not stated.
records.description_es: Refugio de emergencia para hombres, mujeres y niños, además de comidas, duchas, programas de recuperación, manejo de casos y vivienda de transición a largo plazo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias que enfrentan falta de vivienda, crisis, adicción, abuso o pobreza en East Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 759-8101 o vaya a la misión en Longview.

records.name: Longview Housing Authority - Housing Choice Voucher Program
records.description_en: Rental help vouchers (Section 8) so low-income families can rent private homes. Also has homeownership, family self-sufficiency, and veteran housing programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For qualified low-income families in Longview, Kilgore, Henderson, Carthage, and Beckville.
records.how_to_apply: Check waitlist status at waitlistcheck.com/TX666 or email LHA@LongviewTexas.gov.
records.notes: Phone is the number shown on the LHA page (City of Longview main number).
records.description_es: Vales de ayuda para la renta (Sección 8) para que familias de bajos ingresos puedan rentar casas privadas. También tiene programas para comprar casa, para ser autosuficiente y de vivienda para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos que califican en Longview, Kilgore, Henderson, Carthage y Beckville.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise el estado de la lista de espera en waitlistcheck.com/TX666 o escriba a LHA@LongviewTexas.gov.

records.name: Deep East Texas Regional Housing Authority - Housing Choice Vouchers
records.organization: Deep East Texas Council of Governments (DETCOG)
records.description_en: Section 8 rental help with case management for low-income families, seniors, and people with disabilities. Also runs VA Supportive Housing for homeless veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible low-income households in Angelina and other Deep East Texas counties it serves. Nacogdoches County is not listed.
records.how_to_apply: Call (936) 238-7771, email housing@detcog.gov, or visit the office. A waiting list is kept.
records.notes: Serves Angelina, Hardin, Houston, Jasper, Newton, Polk, Sabine, San Augustine, San Jacinto, Shelby, Trinity, and Tyler counties (not the cities of Houston or Tyler). Emergency Housing Voucher program ended 9/30/2023.
records.description_es: Ayuda para la renta de Sección 8 con manejo de casos para familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidades. También ofrece vivienda de apoyo VA para veteranos sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos que califican en Angelina y otros condados de Deep East Texas que atiende. El condado de Nacogdoches no está en la lista.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (936) 238-7771, escriba a housing@detcog.gov o visite la oficina. Hay una lista de espera.

records.name: Port Arthur Transit - Reduced Fares and Paratransit
records.organization: City of Port Arthur Transit Department
records.description_en: City bus service with $0.75 reduced fares for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, and youth 6-18. Door-to-door paratransit is available.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Reduced fare for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, and children 6-18. Proof may be requested. Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult.
records.how_to_apply: Pay the reduced fare with exact change and show proof if asked. For paratransit eligibility, call (409) 983-8794.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 6:15 AM-7:15 PM; Sat 7:15 AM-6:15 PM
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús de la ciudad con tarifa reducida de $0.75 para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y jóvenes de 6 a 18 años. Hay servicio de paratránsito de puerta a puerta.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Tarifa reducida para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y niños de 6 a 18 años. Le pueden pedir comprobante. Los niños menores de 5 años viajan gratis con un adulto que paga.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pague la tarifa reducida con el cambio exacto y muestre su comprobante si se lo piden. Para saber si califica para paratránsito, llame al (409) 983-8794.

records.name: Longview Transit - Discounted Fares and Paratransit
records.description_en: City bus and paratransit service in Longview, with discounted fares for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, and students.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Discounted fares for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, and students.
records.how_to_apply: Call (903) 753-2287 to ask about discounted fares and paratransit.
records.notes: TTY (903) 753-5265. Fare amounts not stated on source.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús y paratránsito de la ciudad en Longview, con tarifas de descuento para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Tarifas de descuento para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (903) 753-2287 para preguntar por tarifas de descuento y paratránsito.

records.name: South East Texas Transit (SETT)
records.organization: South East Texas Regional Planning Commission
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb ride service for health care, shopping, jobs, school, and social services in rural western Jefferson County, Orange County, and Hardin County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves rural western Jefferson County and the Mid-County cities of Groves, Port Neches, and Nederland, mainly for seniors 65 and older and people with disabilities. Call to ask if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call to schedule a ride. Mid-County and rural Jefferson: (409) 892-0979 or (800) 259-4457.
records.cost: Fares vary by county and trip; call for current fares
records.notes: Orange County Transportation (409) 745-9511; Rural Hardin County Transit (409) 892-4455. Program manager (409) 899-8444 x6604.
records.description_es: Servicio de transporte de acera a acera para citas médicas, compras, trabajo, escuela y servicios sociales en el oeste rural del condado de Jefferson, el condado de Orange y el condado de Hardin.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Da servicio en el oeste rural del condado de Jefferson y en las ciudades de Groves, Port Neches y Nederland, principalmente para personas de 65 años o más y personas con discapacidades. Llame para preguntar si califica.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para programar un viaje. Para Mid-County y el área rural de Jefferson: (409) 892-0979 o (800) 259-4457.
